stop_condition_fired.text: Windows hangs, stale-success behavior or Markdown corruption repeats after one clean rerun
instances: rename hang and broken link integrity, reproduced on a second independent note
stale-success on an incomplete semantic index, reproduced after index deletion and rebuild

harness_defect_disclosed.defect: The first corpus revision named files by slug while wikilinks used frontmatter titles. Obsidian resolves [[X]] against the file name, not a title property, so all 13 wikilinks dangled and CLI file= lookups missed. A .base view also used a bare filter list instead of an and/or/not key.
harness_defect_disclosed.correction: Files renamed so filename equals title; .base filter syntax fixed. Corpus re-frozen before the affected checks were rerun.
harness_defect_disclosed.affected_results: link, backlink and .base checks only. Retrieval class results were produced by semantic and literal search, which do not depend on link resolution.
harness_defect_disclosed.outcome_impact: none - every provider failure above is independent of this defect and was observed after the correction
